description: Apache Log4j2 JNDI features do not protect against attacker-controlled LDAP and other JNDI-related endpoints. An attacker who can control log messages or log message parameters can execute arbitrary code.

Microsoft Outlook Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability. An attacker could exploit this by sending a specially crafted email that triggers Outlook to connect to an attacker-controlled server, leaking Net-NTLMv2 hashes.
Citrix Bleed vulnerability in NetScaler ADC and Gateway allows sensitive information disclosure via a buffer overflow, potentially exposing session tokens.
Spring Framework RCE via data binding on JDK 9+ when deployed as a WAR on Tomcat. Remote attackers can execute arbitrary code.
Netlogon Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability (Zerologon). An attacker can establish a vulnerable Netlogon secure channel to a domain controller.
The SMBv1 server in Microsoft Windows allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via crafted packets (EternalBlue).
